opening.argument: The offer is presented as a straightforward shopping promotion with stated conditions, not a deceptive financial scheme. Viewers are told to purchase two qualifying Ziploc bags or containers in one transaction at a participating store, keep and photograph the receipt, and visit a website to submit it for a $9 Fandango code. The speaker also gives ordinary limits: four rewards per person and a July 31 redemption deadline. Where product details are uncertain, the speaker says so. Separate referral and discount offers are presented as shopping or rewards links; nothing described establishes impersonation, victim losses, or a required financial participation flow beyond the stated purchase conditions.
